facts.fact: Nile Post reports the Personal Data Protection Office, headed by director Baker Birikujja, launched an audit and inspection manual on 26 November 2026 and has more than 16,000 entities registered with it.

Nile Post reports the Personal Data Protection Office, headed by director Baker Birikujja, is acting: it ran audits of 15 government bodies from November 2025 to April 2026 and has more than 16,000 entities registered.

The Personal Data Protection Office audited 15 ministries, departments and agencies between November 2025 and April 2026, finding eight non-compliant, five partially compliant and two compliant (average score 63.71%), with no decision against a named body, and launched an inspection manual on 26 November 2026.
Nile Post reports the Personal Data Protection Office, headed by director Baker Birikujja, is operating and has more than 16,000 entities registered.

The Personal Data Protection Office registered more than 16,000 entities, audited 15 government bodies between November 2025 and April 2026, and launched an audit and inspection manual on 26 November 2026.

UGA.note: The document states nothing on who builds or runs government systems.
